description: She wears a burgundy full-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold-and-cream patterned woven borders outline the neckline, bodice sides, sleeve cuffs and skirt hem. Round gold-toned fittings decorate the bodice straps and the waist belt. A cream fabric wrap with burgundy-and-gold border bands rests around the forearms and hangs beside the skirt. A cream underdress panel shows through a small lower front opening, with embroidered burgundy closed shoes beneath the hem. Small metal drop earrings and a dark ring are visible. The fabrics are opaque and textured; exact fibers are uncertain. Upper chest and forearms are exposed while bust, abdomen and pelvis remain covered.
